excerpt.zh: 我们已经见识过了泛星系的真面目，并选择隐居避世。然而我们还是遭到了骚扰，你们真的想看看我们的宝藏吗？那就让你们见识一下。
excerpt.en: We have seen what kind of galaxy it is and chose to avoid it, yet again we are disturbed, do you really want to see our treasures? Then let us show you.

triggers.en: When a fleet enters a system

tooltips.zh: [From.GetName]星系旁边的每个星系都建立起了新的超空间航道。
tooltips.en: Every system near the [From.GetName] system has had new hyperlanes established.
